# #641 — pr-body-gate validates done-means paths against the primary checkout, not the PR branch — refuses every PR introducing a new check

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-08T16:51:10Z
Updated: 2026-08-08T16:51:10Z

---

Found by the #637 lane (PR #638): pr-body-gate.ts resolves the `- Done-means: <path>` line against $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR's working tree. A PR whose done-means check is NEW (exists only on the PR branch) is refused even though the path is valid at the PR's own head — the exact wrong-version class from lane-contract round 5 (a gate checking repo state at a version other than the one under judgment). Every lane introducing a new check hits this and is forced to `gh api` workarounds, which trains route-around behavior.

Second defect from the same lane: BASH_READ_ONLY does not cover all `rg` invocation forms — a read-only `rg -n` search was refused by the reduction-language wall. Reads cannot reduce anything; pure tax.

Fix direction (delta, not redesign): validate the path against the branch/head the PR body belongs to (git show ref:path or the PR head via gh), keeping the primary-checkout check as fallback for pre-push validation; and extend the read-only classifier to cover rg forms. Fixture tests red-first, per scripts/done-means/637-gate-precision.sh prior art.
